slides.title: What do you do when someone pushes back?

body.text: This is your question for today. Keep it in mind during the games.
Three games tonight: standing, guarded, pinned. Win one and the next round gets harder. Lose it and you run the same one again.
Skill Learning Objective (SLO): Entering, for both players.
Both players stand. The underhook player has an underhook. The overhook player counters with an overhook.
Underhook player: use the underhook to move your partner and attach to a single leg, then pick it up. Overhook player: use the overhook to keep him away from that leg.

items: The underhook player wins by attaching to and picking up the overhook player's leg.
The overhook player wins by stopping him for 30 seconds.

body.text: SLO: Arriving for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
Open guard. The bottom player is on his back. The top player is standing or kneeling in front of him.

Bottom player: use only posts and hooks, no leg entanglements and no attaching to the hips, to put the top player's hips on the floor. Top player: do not get put down. Work to pass or keep the top position.

items: The bottom player wins by putting the top player's hips on the floor using only posts and hooks.
The top player wins by stopping the bottom player's win for 30 seconds. Then you switch roles.

body.text: SLO: Controlling for the top player, Leaving for the bottom player.
The bottom player is on his hands and knees. The top player is on top with open hands around the bottom player's hips.
Top player: stay attached to the hips, break the bottom player down, and stop him from standing. Bottom player: build your base, fight to your feet, and turn to face the top player.

items: The top player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps the bottom player broken down.
The bottom player wins by standing up and turning to face the top player.

slides.title: How you win it
slides.question: In Riding Bottom Position Game, what wins it for the top player?

options.text: The top player has no time limit. He holds as long as he keeps the bottom player broken down.
options.feedback: That is the win condition, and nothing else scores.

options.text: Holding the finish after your partner taps
options.feedback: Never. Let go the instant your partner taps. Every single time. The tap is law.
You keep the pin by feeling your partner and moving with them, not by clamping down and squeezing hard. Staying calm beats forcing harder.

slides.correctText: That is how you win today.
